name: Wormhole Card
description: Tilting glass card with a perspective wormhole grid behind it, where glowing icon orbs drift out of the tunnel on a looping timeline above a tag, title and description.
contents: Card with tag chip, gradient title and description with highlighted phrase
Wormhole wireframe of ellipses, curves and points
Looping glowing orbs with icons and orbiting sparks
behavior: Card tilts in 3D following the pointer and eases back on leave
Orbs fly out of the tunnel in staggered loops and fade
Small sparks orbit and bob around each orb
